visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair tied in a bun, wearing a black low-cut top and light-wash jeans with colorful patches, stands on a city sidewalk. She looks back at the camera with a playful smile while holding a smartphone. Storefronts with Chinese characters and parked scooters are visible in the background. (2) The scene shifts indoors to a brightly lit, modern commercial space with white walls and glass doors. The woman enters the facility and begins interacting with a female staff member wearing a brown apron and a white face mask. They stand near a white cabinet featuring decorative floral arrangements. (3) The woman gestures toward pink product boxes on the counter. She picks up one of the boxes, which features a lychee illustration, and holds it up for the camera. The staff member gestures enthusiastically with her hands. (4) The woman and the staff member move to a different area of the room. The staff member holds up an empty, flattened cardboard box, gesturing that the contents are gone. The woman reacts with surprised facial expressions and poses with her hands on her hips. (5) The woman walks toward an interior hallway. She looks back at the camera, smiling, before reaching out with her hand to cover the camera lens, creating a transition to a black screen with white text.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Location Entry -> Product Showcase -> Sales Proof -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional vlog designed to endorse a breast care jelly product and a beauty clinic. It utilizes a relatable lifestyle format to build social proof by showing empty shipment boxes and personal testimonials from the shop staff.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product boxes, verbal recommendation by staff, and explicit inclusion of store address and brand names in text overlays.
